architecture_context.project_summary: A platform designed to foster collaboration and resource sharing between university alumni and current students. It enables users to manage profiles, share posts (including internship opportunities), access a technical library of resources, and browse directories of other users.
features: Personalized User Dashboards (Student Home, Alumni Home)
Profile Management (View and Edit personal details, skills, experiences/events)
Content Posting (Text and Image posts for general updates or achievements)
Internship Opportunity Sharing (Alumni can post internships)
Internship Feed (Students and Alumni can view internship posts)
Technical Resource Library (Categorized storage and access for educational materials)
Resource Upload (Alumni can upload projects, papers, and placement resources)
Alumni Directory (Students can search and view alumni profiles)
Student Directory (Alumni can search and view student profiles)

user_journeys.name: New Student Onboarding & Profile Setup
steps: Student logs in for the first time with provided credentials.
System detects no existing profile and redirects to 'Edit Student Profile'.
Student fills in academic details, interested companies, skills, and event participations.
Student saves their profile.
Student is redirected to their personalized Student Home dashboard.

user_journeys.name: Alumni Sharing a Technical Resource
steps: Alumni logs into the platform.
Navigates to the 'Access Tech Library' section from the dashboard.
Selects a relevant folder (e.g., 'Projects' or 'Placement Resources').
Clicks 'Upload New File' and selects a document from their local system.
The file is uploaded to the library and becomes accessible to all users.

user_journeys.name: Student Discovering Internship Opportunities
steps: Student logs into the platform.
Navigates to the 'Intern Scoop' section from the dashboard sidebar.
Browses through a dedicated feed of internship opportunities posted by alumni.
Views details of specific internship posts (title, description, image, poster information).

user_journeys.name: Alumni Posting a General Update/Achievement
steps: Alumni logs into the platform.
Clicks the 'Post' button in the main header.
Enters a title and description for their update (e.g., a new job, industry insight).
Optionally uploads an image to accompany the post.
Submits the post, making it visible on the home feeds and their 'My Posts' section.

user_journeys.name: Student Searching for Alumni Contact
steps: Student logs into the platform.
Navigates to the 'Alumni Directory' from the dashboard sidebar.
Enters a search query (e.g., alumni name, current company) into the search bar.
Views a filtered list of alumni profiles matching the search criteria, including their working place and passed out year.

services.name: User Authentication Service
services.description: Manages user login, validates credentials against the database, and assigns role-based access to the platform. It handles session management post-login.

services.name: User Profile Management Service
services.description: Handles the creation, retrieval, and updates of detailed profiles for both students and alumni, including skills, experiences, and academic/professional data.

services.name: Content Posting Service
services.description: Manages user-generated posts, including creating new posts, retrieving posts by a specific user, fetching recent posts for home feeds, and filtering posts for specific categories like internships.
endpoints: GET /recent-posts (fetch recent and trending posts for dashboards)

services.name: Technical Library Service
services.description: Facilitates the upload, storage, and retrieval of educational and technical resources by alumni. Resources are organized into folders and made available for download.
endpoints: POST /techLibrary/upload (upload files to a specific folder)

services.name: Directory Search Service
services.description: Provides functionality to search and list users (alumni or students) based on various criteria, enabling networking and discovery within the platform.

services.name: File Storage and Serving Service
services.description: Manages the persistent storage of all user-uploaded content (images for posts, documents for the Tech Library) on the server's local file system and serves them via dedicated endpoints.
endpoints: GET /upload/:fileName (serves static files from the upload directory)

data_entities.name: User
data_entities.description: Represents an authenticated user in the system, primarily for login.

data_entities.name: Student Profile
data_entities.description: Detailed profile information for a student user, stored in the 'studentProfile' collection.

data_entities.name: Alumni Profile
data_entities.description: Detailed profile information for an alumni user, stored in the 'alumniProfile' collection.

data_entities.name: Post
data_entities.description: User-generated content, including general updates, achievements, or internship opportunities.
attributes: email (FK to User, email of the poster)

data_entities.name: Tech Library Item
data_entities.description: Metadata for files uploaded to the technical resource library, stored in the 'TechLibrary' collection.
attributes: filePath (server path to the stored file)

external_systems.name: MongoDB Database
external_systems.description: A NoSQL document database used for persistent storage of all application data, including user credentials, profiles, posts, and tech library metadata.

external_systems.name: Local File System
external_systems.description: The server's local storage used for storing uploaded binary files (images for posts, documents for the Tech Library) to conserve database space and optimize retrieval.

entry_points.name: Web Browser / User Interface
entry_points.description: The primary interaction point for end-users, providing the React-based frontend application for all user journeys.
access_methods: Direct URL access (e.g., '/', '/profile', '/internscoop') which loads the React application.

entry_points.name: Backend API (Express.js)
entry_points.description: A RESTful API layer that processes requests from the frontend application, handling data persistence, retrieval, and business logic.

system_flow.title: Alumni-Student Interaction Platform
system_flow.description: The Alumni-Student Interaction Platform is a full-stack web application facilitating collaboration and resource sharing between university alumni and current students. It supports user authentication, personalized dashboards, comprehensive profile management, content posting (including internship opportunities), a curated technical resource library, and searchable directories of both student and alumni profiles.

nodes.label: User (Student/Alumni)
nodes.description: Interacts with the web application through their browser to access features like profiles, posts, and resources.

nodes.label: Web Browser Frontend (React.js)
nodes.description: The client-side application built with React.js, responsible for rendering all user interfaces, handling client-side routing, and user interactions.

nodes.label: User Authentication Workflow
nodes.description: Manages user login, credential input, role selection (Student/Alumni), and initial authentication process.

nodes.label: Auth & Profile API (Node.js/Express)
nodes.description: Backend service handling user login validation, session management, and CRUD operations for both student and alumni profiles.

nodes.label: MongoDB Database
nodes.description: The NoSQL database used for persistent storage of all application data, including user credentials, detailed profiles, post metadata, and technical library item metadata.

nodes.label: Student/Alumni Dashboards
nodes.description: Personalized home screens for each user role, displaying recent posts, suggested content, and providing navigation to other platform features.

nodes.label: Profile Management UI
nodes.description: User interface allowing students and alumni to view, edit, and update their personal, academic, and professional details.

nodes.label: Content Posting UI
nodes.description: An interactive popup allowing users (students/alumni) to create and submit new text-based posts with optional image uploads.

nodes.label: Post & Feed API (Node.js/Express)
nodes.description: Backend service managing the creation of new posts, retrieval of posts by user, recent/trending posts, and filtered internship posts.

nodes.label: Local File Storage (Server FS)
nodes.description: The server's local file system dedicated to storing uploaded binary files such as post images and technical library documents.

nodes.label: My Posts View
nodes.description: A dedicated page displaying all content (posts, achievements) created by the currently logged-in user.

nodes.label: Internship Feed View
nodes.description: A curated feed showing only posts identified as internship opportunities, accessible to both students and alumni.

nodes.label: Technical Library UI
nodes.description: Interface for browsing categorized educational resources (projects, papers). Alumni can upload, all users can download.

nodes.label: Tech Library API (Node.js/Express)
nodes.description: Backend service for uploading new files to the technical library, storing their metadata, and retrieving files by folder.

nodes.label: User Directory UI
nodes.description: Searchable directory allowing students to find alumni based on name, company, or year (and potentially vice-versa for students).

edges.label: Navigates to My Posts

api_flow.title: Alumni Post Creation Flow (with Authentication Context)
api_flow.description: Details the process for an alumni user to log in and then create a new post with an image. This flow illustrates the complete request lifecycle including authentication, middleware, database interactions, file storage, and error paths.

nodes.label: Client (Web Browser)
nodes.description: User interacts with the React frontend application (login page, alumni home, post creation form).

nodes.label: POST /auth/login
nodes.description: Endpoint for user authentication (students and alumni).

nodes.label: Auth Validation Service
nodes.description: Validates user's email, password, and role against stored credentials.

nodes.label: MongoDB (Users)
nodes.description: Authenticates user against 'studentProfile' or 'alumniProfile' collections in the 'studentApp' database.

nodes.label: 200 OK (Login Success)
nodes.description: User successfully logged in; client receives confirmation and user role.

nodes.label: 401 Unauthorized (Login Failed)
nodes.description: Invalid email, password, or role provided during login attempt.

nodes.label: POST /posts
nodes.description: Endpoint for an authenticated user (Alumni or Student) to create a new post with an optional image.

nodes.label: Auth/Role Check Middleware
nodes.description: Conceptually, this middleware would ensure the request is from an authenticated user with appropriate permissions (e.g., 'alumni').

nodes.label: Multer File Upload Middleware
nodes.description: Processes the incoming image file. If successful, stores it temporarily and makes file info available in `req.file`.

nodes.label: Post Data Validation Service
nodes.description: Validates essential post fields (title, description) and confirms image file presence (if required).

nodes.label: Local File System (Post Images)
nodes.description: The server's local storage where uploaded post images are saved persistently in `public/uploads`.

nodes.label: Content Posting Service Logic
nodes.description: Orchestrates the creation of the post record, combining text data with the stored image path.

nodes.label: MongoDB (Posts)
nodes.description: Inserts the post's metadata (email, title, description, image path, date) into the 'posts' collection.

nodes.label: 201 Created (Post Success)
nodes.description: Post successfully created and stored in the database and file system.

nodes.label: Error: 401 Unauthorized
nodes.description: Request to /posts is made by an unauthenticated user or one lacking necessary roles.

nodes.label: Error: 400 Invalid Input
nodes.description: Missing required post fields (title, description) or no image file provided for the post.

nodes.label: Error: 500 Server/DB Failure
nodes.description: An unexpected error occurred during post processing, file storage, or database interaction.

edges.label: Login Request
edges.description: User submits email, password, and role from the login form.

edges.label: Forward Credentials
edges.description: The login endpoint passes credentials to the authentication service.

edges.label: Query User Credentials
edges.description: Authentication service queries MongoDB to find and validate the user.

edges.label: User Found/Validated
edges.description: MongoDB returns matching user data; validation succeeds.

edges.label: User Not Found/Invalid
edges.description: MongoDB finds no matching user or password check fails.

edges.label: Return Success Response
edges.description: Authentication successful; send 200 OK.

edges.label: Return Failure Response
edges.description: Authentication failed; send 401 Unauthorized.

edges.label: Login Success (Redirect to Home)
edges.description: Client redirects to the appropriate dashboard (e.g., AlumniHome) and updates its state.

edges.label: Login Failure (Display Error)
edges.description: Client displays an error message to the user on the login screen.

edges.label: Create Post Request (After Login)
edges.description: An authenticated user (e.g., Alumni) submits new post data and an image.

edges.label: Verify Authorization
edges.description: The request is passed to the authentication/role checking middleware.

edges.label: Unauthorized Access (401)
edges.description: If the user is not authenticated or lacks permission, an unauthorized error is returned.

edges.label: Authorized (Proceed to Upload)
edges.description: User is authorized; Multer middleware processes the uploaded file.

edges.label: Store Image File
edges.description: Multer saves the uploaded image to the server's local file system (public/uploads directory).

edges.label: Forward Post Data & File Info
edges.description: The post body data and details about the uploaded file are passed to the validation service.

edges.label: No File Uploaded (400)
edges.description: Multer detects that no file was attached when one was expected for the post.

edges.label: Invalid Post Data (400)
edges.description: Validation fails due to missing post title, description, or other invalid data.

edges.label: Data Valid (Proceed to DB)
edges.description: Post data is valid; the content posting logic is initiated.

edges.label: Insert Post Metadata
edges.description: The service inserts the post details (including the path to the saved image) into the 'posts' collection in MongoDB.

edges.label: DB Operation Result
edges.description: MongoDB returns the result of the insert operation to the service logic.

edges.label: Return Success Response
edges.description: Post successfully inserted; send a 201 Created response to the client.

edges.label: Server/DB Error (500)
edges.description: An error occurred within the content posting logic or during database interaction.

edges.label: Post Success (Update UI)
edges.description: Client receives success, closes popup, and potentially refreshes feed or shows confirmation message.

edges.label: Show Error to User
edges.description: Client displays an authorization error message to the user.

edges.label: Show Error to User
edges.description: Client displays the input validation error message to the user.

edges.label: Show Error to User
edges.description: Client displays a generic server error message to the user.

data_flow.title: Alumni-Student Platform: Content & Discovery Flow
data_flow.description: This data flow diagram illustrates the journey of a user login, an alumni creating a new post (including image upload), and a student discovering internship opportunities.

nodes.label: Login Request Payload
nodes.description: User provides email, password (which maps to the 'name' field in profiles), and role (student/alumni) for authentication. Sent via POST /auth/login.

nodes.label: User Profiles (MongoDB)
nodes.description: Stores 'studentProfile' and 'alumniProfile' collections. Serves as source for user credential validation during login (matching email and 'name' as password) and for storing/retrieving detailed profile data. Relationships: 'email' is primary key.

nodes.label: Authenticated User Session
nodes.description: Represents the data of a successfully logged-in user, including their email and assigned role. This session enables authorized actions and personalizes content.

nodes.label: Alumni Post Creation Request
nodes.description: Alumni submits a form containing the post title, description, and an optional image file. Triggered by 'Post' button, sent via POST /posts.

nodes.label: Uploaded Post Image (Local FS)
nodes.description: The binary image file (e.g., JPEG, PNG) associated with a post is stored on the server's local file system at `/public/uploads` by the Multer middleware.

nodes.label: Post Metadata
nodes.description: Structured data representing a single post, including the poster's email, title, description, the server path to the uploaded image, and the creation timestamp.

nodes.label: Posts Collection (MongoDB)
nodes.description: Persistent storage for all user-generated content posts. Each document stores 'Post Metadata'. Relationships: 'email' attribute links to the 'User Profiles' for poster identity.

nodes.label: Internship Post Filtering
nodes.description: Backend logic (GET /internposts) queries the 'Posts Collection', filters posts whose 'title' contains 'internship' (case-insensitive), and potentially enriches with poster's name (fetching from User Profiles DB via GET /getname/:email).

nodes.label: Internship Post List
nodes.description: A curated list of internship opportunity posts, each containing relevant details and potentially the poster's name, ready for display.

nodes.label: Intern Scoop UI Display
nodes.description: The filtered and enriched 'Internship Post List' is serialized to JSON and returned to the frontend to be rendered on the student's 'Intern Scoop' dashboard.

edges.label: Auth Request (Read)
edges.description: POST /auth/login uses email/password to validate against stored user profiles.

edges.label: Login Success (Create)
edges.description: If credentials are valid, an authenticated user session is established with role and email.

edges.label: Alumni Creates Post
edges.description: An authenticated alumni initiates the process to create a new post.

edges.label: Image Upload (Write)
edges.description: The image part of the FormData is processed by Multer and saved to the local file system.

edges.label: Extract Text Data
edges.description: Text fields (title, description, email, date) are extracted from the FormData.

edges.label: Add Image Path
edges.description: The generated file path of the stored image is added to the post metadata.

edges.label: Store Post (Write)
edges.description: POST /posts inserts the complete 'Post Metadata' document into the MongoDB 'posts' collection.

edges.label: Student Requests Intern Scoop
edges.description: An authenticated student requests to view internship opportunities.

edges.label: Fetch Posts (Read)
edges.description: GET /internposts retrieves all relevant posts from the 'posts' collection for filtering.

edges.label: Fetch Poster Names (Read)
edges.description: During filtering, poster names are fetched from 'User Profiles' (via 'getname' endpoint) to enrich internship posts.

edges.label: Generate Internship List
edges.description: Filtered and enriched posts are assembled into the 'Internship Post List' model.

edges.label: Render UI
edges.description: The 'Internship Post List' is provided to the client for rendering the 'Intern Scoop' interface.
